reauth_confirm.title: Renew Famalio Home access
reauth_confirm.description: Create a new integration token in Famalio and enter it here.

hassio_confirm.title: Connect the Famalio calendar
hassio_confirm.description: The installation assistant prepared access to {url}. Confirm to add this calendar. An existing connection to the same family will be updated.

user.title: Set up Famalio Home
user.description: Famalio Home needs the Famalio server. Install it on this Home Assistant automatically, or connect a server you already run.

menu_options.install_app: Install the Famalio server on this Home Assistant (recommended)
menu_options.manual: I already have a Famalio server

manual.title: Connect to Famalio Home
manual.description: Use an HTTPS server address and an integration token created by a Famalio family owner.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS origin without a path.
error.invalid_auth: The integration token is invalid or revoked.
error.server_changed: This token belongs to a different Famalio family or server. Remove this entry and add the other server separately.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or the server returned an invalid response.

abort.already_configured: This Famalio integration is already configured.
abort.invalid_discovery: The installation assistant supplied invalid connection information.
abort.already_in_progress: A connection to this family is already being configured.
abort.app_installed: The Famalio server is installed and running. Open Famalio in the Home Assistant sidebar and follow the three steps there.
abort.install_failed: The Famalio server could not be installed automatically ({error}). Add https://github.com/fisch192/famalio-home in Settings, Apps, Install app, menu, Repositories, then install Famalio there.
abort.no_supervisor: This Home Assistant has no Supervisor, so apps cannot be installed here. Install the Famalio server with the Linux installer or Docker Compose from https://github.com/fisch192/famalio-home and add this integration again.

progress.install_app: Installing the Famalio server. This builds the app on your Home Assistant and can take 10 to 20 minutes. You can leave this page open or close it.

init.title: Calendar refresh interval
init.description: How often Home Assistant checks Famalio Home for calendar changes. Choose from 30 to 3600 seconds.
